title: Captions
info: A caption is a short text next to a picture. It tells you what the picture shows.
Read the caption and the picture together. The words can add a fact the picture cannot say alone.

questions.q: A photo of a river labeled Padma River near Rajshahi uses the caption to
options: replace the photo with a song

questions.q: If the picture shows a bird and the caption names it, you should
options: decide captions are titles of books only
cannot be on the same page
